# fossa_service_account (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) The username for the service account

### Optional

- `email` (String) Optional email address for the service account
- `full_name` (String) Optional full name/description for the service account
- `has_full_api_token` (Boolean) Whether to create a full access API token for the service account
- `has_push_only_api_token` (Boolean) Whether to create a push-only API token for the service account
- `org_role_id` (Number) ID of the organization role to assign to the service account. At least one of orgRoleId or team must be provided.
- `team` (Attributes) Team assignment for the service account. At least one of orgRoleId or team must be provided. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--team))

### Read-Only

- `full_api_token` (String, Sensitive) Full-access API token returned only at creation time by FOSSA. Terraform stores it in state; it cannot be re-read later.
- `id` (Number) The user id of the service account
- `is_service_account` (Boolean) Whether the user is a service account
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization the user belongs to
- `push_only_api_token` (String, Sensitive) Push-only API token returned only at creation time by FOSSA. Terraform stores it in state; it cannot be re-read later.

<a id="nestedatt--team"></a>
### Nested Schema for `team`

Required:

- `id` (Number) ID of the team to assign the service account to
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the team role to assign
